about: mbx's machine-wide pool on an 18-core host, 2026-10-30 from 21:33:20Z for ten minutes: every admission whose wait or hold overlaps the window, from mbx's observation log (arrival = end - run - admission wait), times in milliseconds from the window's start. One lease the observation log lacks is added from the decision log: a one-cpu test binary admitted at -64.7 s that ran until it was killed just before the 18-cpu reservation's grant at 529.4 s.
